reviews.title: Great Refurbished Drives
reviews.comment: Needed replacement drives for my CTV Security system and these arrived individually wrapped and sealed in an anti-static bag.  Ran diagnostics on all three drives I purchased and not one error detected.  Will order more from them as needed.
